english: Flip 3 coins. For each heads, discard the top 3 cards of your opponent's deck.
chinese: 抛掷3次硬币，从对手牌库上方将出现正面次数×3张卡牌放于弃牌区。

english: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, they can't play any Item cards from their hand.
chinese: 抛掷1次硬币如果为正面，则在下一个对手的回合，对手无法从手牌使出物品。

english: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage and heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.
chinese: 抛掷1次硬币如果为正面，则追加造成30伤害，回复这只宝可梦「30」HP。

english: Flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.
chinese: 抛掷硬币直到出现反面，选择对手战斗宝可梦身上附着的与出现正面次数相同数量的能量，放于弃牌区。

english: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.
chinese: 抛掷1次硬币如果为反面，则这个招式失败。如果为正面，则在下一个对手的回合，这只宝可梦不受到招式的伤害和效果影响。

english: Flip a coin. If tails, this Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.
chinese: 抛掷1次硬币如果为正面，则追加造成20伤害。如果为反面，则给这只宝可梦也造成20伤害。

english: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 90 damage for each heads. If the first flip is tails, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.
chinese: 抛掷硬币直到出现反面，造成正面次数×90伤害。如果最初抛掷的硬币为反面的话，则令对手的战斗宝可梦陷入'''{{TCG|混乱}}'''状态。

english: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for up to 2 Basic {{e|水}} Energy cards and attach them to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.
chinese: 抛掷1次硬币如果为正面，则选择自己牌库中最多2张「基本{{e|水}}能量」，附着于这只宝可梦身上。并重洗牌库。

english: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed and Poisoned.
chinese: 抛掷1次硬币如果为正面，则令对手的战斗宝可梦陷入'''{{TCG|中毒}}'''和'''{{TCG|麻痹}}'''状态。

english: Flip a coin. If heads, heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.
chinese: 抛掷1次硬币如果为正面，则回复这只宝可梦「30」HP。

english: Flip 2 coins. If both are heads, this attack does 20 more damage.
chinese: 抛掷2次硬币，如果全为正面的话，则追加造成20伤害。

english: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is Knocked Out.
chinese: 抛掷2次硬币，如果全为正面的话，则令对手战斗宝可梦'''昏厥'''。

english: Flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, discard a random card from your opponent's hand.
chinese: 抛掷硬币直到出现反面，在不看正面的前提下，选择与出现正面次数相同数量的对手的手牌，放于弃牌区。

english: Flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, draw a card.
chinese: 抛掷硬币直到出现反面，从自己牌库上方抽取与出现正面次数相同数量的卡牌。

english: Flip a coin. If tails, discard all Energy from this Pokémon.
chinese: 抛掷1次硬币如果为反面，则将这只宝可梦身上附着的能量，全部放于弃牌区。

english: Flip a coin. If heads, discard a random card from your opponent’s hand.
chinese: 抛掷1次硬币如果为正面，则在不看对手手牌正面的前提下，选择其中1张放于弃牌区。

english: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 140 more damage. If tails, during your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.
chinese: 抛掷1次硬币如果为正面，则追加造成140伤害。如果为反面，则在下一个自己的回合，这只宝可梦无法使用招式。

english: Flip a coin. If tails, this Pokémon also does 60 damage to itself.
chinese: 抛掷1次硬币如果为反面，则给这只宝可梦也造成60伤害。

english: Flip 3 coins. If 1 of them is heads, this attack does 20 more damage. If 2 of them are heads, this attack does 60 more damage. If all of them are heads, this attack does 120 more damage.
chinese: 抛掷3次硬币。如果出现1次正面，则追加造成20伤害。如果出现2次，则追加造成60伤害。如果全为正面的话，则追加造成120伤害。

english: Flip 3 coins. Put a number of cards up to the number of heads from your discard pile into your hand.
chinese: 抛掷3次硬币，选择自己弃牌区中最多与出现正面次数相同数量的任意卡牌，在给对手看过之后，加入手牌。

english: Flip 3 coins. For each tails, discard an Energy from this Pokémon.
chinese: 抛掷3次硬币，选择与出现反面次数相同数量的这只宝可梦身上附着的能量，放于弃牌区。

english: Flip 3 coins. For each heads, discard a random card from your opponent's hand.
chinese: 抛掷3次硬币，在不看正面的前提下，选择与出现正面次数相同数量的对手的手牌，放于弃牌区。

english: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused and Poisoned.
chinese: 抛掷1次硬币如果为正面，则令对手的战斗宝可梦陷入'''{{TCG|中毒}}'''和'''{{TCG|混乱}}'''状态。

english: Flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.
chinese: 抛掷硬币直到出现反面，选择对手战斗宝可梦身上附着的与出现正面次数相同数量的能量，放于弃牌区。

english: Flip 2 coins. For each heads, discard the top card of your opponent's deck.
chinese: 抛掷2次硬币，从对手牌库上方将与出现正面次数相同数量的卡牌放于弃牌区。

english: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 90 damage for each heads. If both of them are tails, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.
chinese: 抛掷2次硬币，造成正面次数×90伤害。如果全部为反面，则令对手的战斗宝可梦陷入'''{{TCG|混乱}}'''状态。

english: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed and Poisoned.
chinese: 抛掷1次硬币如果为正面，则令对手的战斗宝可梦陷入'''{{TCG|中毒}}'''和'''{{TCG|麻痹}}'''状态。

english: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed, and discard an Energy from that Pokémon.
chinese: 抛掷1次硬币如果为正面，则令对手的战斗宝可梦陷入'''{{TCG|麻痹}}'''状态。另外，选择那只宝可梦身上附着的1个能量，放于弃牌区。

english: Flip 3 coins. If 1 of them is heads, this attack does 20 more damage. If 2 of them are heads, this attack does 50 more damage. If all of them are heads, this attack does 80 more damage.
chinese: 抛掷3次硬币。如果出现1次正面，则追加造成20伤害。如果出现2次正面，则追加造成50伤害。如果全为正面的话，则追加造成80伤害。

english: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage, and heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.
chinese: 抛掷1次硬币，如果为正面，则追加造成30伤害，回复这只宝可梦「30」HP。

english: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are tails, this Pokémon also does 90 damage to itself.
chinese: 抛掷2次硬币，如果全部为反面，则给这只宝可梦也造成90伤害。

english: Flip a coin until you get tails. Search your deck for an amount of Basic {{e|Lightning}} Energy up to the number of heads and attach it to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.
chinese: 抛掷硬币直到出现反面，选择自己牌库中最多与出现正面次数相同数量的「基本{{e|雷}}能量」，附着于这只宝可梦身上。并重洗牌库。

english: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a card and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
chinese: 抛掷1次硬币，如果为正面，则选择自己牌库中任意1张卡牌，加入手牌。并重洗牌库。

english: Flip 3 coins. For each heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.
chinese: 抛掷3次硬币，选择对手战斗宝可梦身上附着的与出现正面次数相同数量的能量，放于弃牌区。

english: Flip a coin. If heads, choose a Special Condition. Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now affected by that Special Condition.
chinese: 抛掷1次硬币如果为正面，则选择1种特殊状态，令对手的战斗宝可梦陷入该特殊状态中。

english: Flip 2 coins. Search your deck for a number of {{e|草}} Pokémon up to the number of heads and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.
chinese: 抛掷2次硬币，选择自己牌库中最多与出现正面次数相同数量的{{e|草}}宝可梦，放于备战区。并重洗牌库。

english: Flip a coin. If heads, move an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon to 1 of their Benched Pokémon.
chinese: 抛掷1次硬币如果为正面，则选择对手战斗宝可梦身上附着的1个能量，转附于对手的备战宝可梦身上。

english: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a card and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. If tails, discard a card from your hand.
chinese: 抛掷1次硬币如果为正面，则选择自己牌库中任意1张卡牌，加入手牌。并重洗牌库。如果为反面，则选择自己的1张手牌，放于弃牌区。

english: Flip a coin. If heads, Knock Out your opponent's Active Basic Pokémon. If tails, Knock Out 1 of your opponent's Benched Basic Pokémon.
chinese: 抛掷1次硬币如果为正面，则令对手战斗场上的'''基础'''宝可梦'''昏厥'''。如果为反面，则选择对手备战区中的1只'''基础'''宝可梦，令那只宝可梦'''昏厥'''。

english: Flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, shuffle an Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon into their deck.
chinese: 抛掷硬币直到出现反面，选择对手战斗宝可梦身上附着的与出现正面次数相同数量的能量，放回对手牌库并重洗牌库。

english: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.
chinese: 抛掷1次硬币，如果为正面，则在下一个对手的回合，受到这个招式影响的宝可梦无法撤退。
